notes.title: Major update! "Lost: Find" is now officially online! ! !

Thank you for your love and support for us all the time. Now we have launched the new game "Lost: Find"!

If you are interested, please search and play~ The first release is being discounted, without further ado, let us quickly start the adventure, Unexpected brand new version, don’t miss it!
